title: Option to hide notifications from screencast instead of disabling them (and maybe make it the default)
line: A new "Hide from screen recordings and screenshots" option in the Notifications settings keeps popups on your screen but out of screen sharing, recordings and screenshots.
explanation: While screen sharing, the only way to keep notifications out of the stream was the "Do Not Disturb during screen sharing" option, which suppresses popups entirely so people miss them. KWin already removes capture-excluded windows from screencasts and screenshots, but a shell surface like a notification popup had no way to ask for it: the flag could only be set by window rules, the window menu or the task manager. The change adds a set_exclude_from_capture request to the plasma-shell protocol (v9), implements it in KWin, exposes it in libplasma's PlasmaShellWaylandIntegration, and adds a Popups option in the Notifications settings (HidePopupsFromCapture, off by default) that the popups follow live.

commits.message:
plasma-shell: add set_exclude_from_capture request

Shell surfaces such as notification popups had no way to keep themselves
out of screen recordings and screenshots. Version 9 adds a request that
asks the compositor to exclude the surface from screen capture.

BUG: 528880

wayland: let plasma shell surfaces exclude themselves from capture

Only window rules, the window menu and the task manager could hide a
window from screen capture, so shell surfaces like notification popups
couldn't opt out. Implement set_exclude_from_capture from plasma-shell v9.

BUG: 528880

plasmaquick: add PlasmaShellWaylandIntegration::setExcludeFromCapture

Plasma windows had no way to ask the compositor to keep them out of
screen recordings and screenshots. Bind plasma-shell version 9 and expose
its set_exclude_from_capture request, sent when the surface is created.

BUG: 528880

applets/notifications: add option to hide popups from screen capture

The only way to keep notifications out of a screencast was to enable Do
Not Disturb, which made people miss them. Add a Popups option that keeps
notification popups visible on screen but excludes them from capture.

BUG: 528880

patches.diff:
From 6f24893fd037835b7f241f0bd747efb7fc46d77b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 19:06:00 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] plasma-shell: add set_exclude_from_capture request

Shell surfaces such as notification popups had no way to keep themselves
out of screen recordings and screenshots. Version 9 adds a request that
asks the compositor to exclude the surface from screen capture.

BUG: 528880
---
 src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml | 12 ++++++++++--
 1 file changed, 10 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml b/src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml
index baca1af..3600303 100644
--- a/src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml
+++ b/src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml
@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@
     SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.1-or-later
   ]]></copyright>
 
-  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_shell" version="8">
+  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_shell" version="9">
     <description summary="create shell windows and helpers">
       This interface is used by KF5 powered Wayland shells to communicate with
       the compositor and can only be bound one time.
@@ -31,7 +31,7 @@
     </request>
   </interface>
 
-  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_surface" version="8">
+  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_surface" version="9">
     <description summary="metadata interface">
       An interface that may be implemented by a wl_surface, for
       implementations that provide the shell user interface.
@@ -304,5 +304,13 @@
         cursor position. Has to be called before attaching any buffer to this surface.
       </description>
     </request>
+
+    <request name="set_exclude_from_capture" since="9">
+      <description summary="exclude the surface from screen capture">
+        Setting this bit will indicate that the window should not be visible
+        in screen recordings, screen sharing and screenshots.
+      </description>
+      <arg name="exclude" type="uint" summary="Boolean value that sets whether to exclude the window from capture."/>
+    </request>
   </interface>
 </protocol>
--

review.text: Done at the right layers: a plasma-shell v9 request, KWin mapping it onto its existing excludeFromCapture, a version-checked libplasma API, and a default-off notifications setting the popups follow live. It reuses KWin's existing capture filtering instead of adding notification-specific policy there, and screencast and screenshot media show the popup missing while it's still mapped. Merge order and the needed plasma-wayland-protocols version bump and find_package minimums are noted correctly.
